paragraphs: Rabbi Yonatan son of Yose son of Lakonya—the ‘Yose son of’ is parenthetical in the source—asked his brother Shimon, who took a clod and threw it at him: Shevuot 18b. In the Jerusalem Talmud, Horayot 2:5, Rabbi Yonatan asked Rabbi Shimon son of Rabbi Yose ben Lakonya, who wanted to throw a stone after him. In the days of Rabbi Shimon ben Yochai and Rabbenu HaKadosh. They were priests, as related in Bekhorot.
